    Directed algebras with vertex idempotents #

    DirData A records a complete set of orthogonal idempotents e x (zero outside a set T of live points), arrows Arr between live points without oriented cycles, the facts that e_x A e_x = k e_x and that e_y A e_x ≠ 0 only along paths x ⇝ y, and that the radical of A e_x is generated by the arrows out of x. Piece algebras and their convex subpieces are of this kind.

    Each live point has a character χ_x : A → k with e_x a e_x = χ_x(a) e_x (chi), multiplicative by directedness.

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.AR.DirData (k A : Type u) [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] :
    Type (max 1 u)

    A directed algebra with vertex idempotents and arrows.

    • ι : Type
    • fin : Fintype self.ι
    • dec : DecidableEq self.ι
    • e : self.ι → A
    • idem (x : self.ι) : IsIdempotentElem (self.e x)
    • orth (x y : self.ι) : x ≠ y → self.e x * self.e y = 0
    • sum : ∑ x : self.ι, self.e x = 1
    • T : Set self.ι
    • zero (v : self.ι) : v ∉ self.T → self.e v = 0
    • ne (x : self.ι) : x ∈ self.T → self.e x ≠ 0
    • local_ (x : self.ι) (a : A) : ∃ (c : k), self.e x * a * self.e x = c • self.e x
    • Arr : self.ι → self.ι → Prop
    • arrT (x y : self.ι) : self.Arr x y → x ∈ self.T ∧ y ∈ self.T
    • hom (x y : self.ι) (a : A) : self.e y * a * self.e x ≠ 0 → Relation.ReflTransGen self.Arr x y
    • acyc (x y : self.ι) : Relation.TransGen self.Arr x y → ¬Relation.ReflTransGen self.Arr y x
    • gen (x : self.ι) (a : A) : (1 - self.e x) * a * self.e x ∈ Submodule.span A {r : A | ∃ (y : self.ι) (b : A), self.Arr x y ∧ r = self.e y * b * self.e x}
    • arrNe (x y : self.ι) : self.Arr x y → ∃ (a : A), self.e y * a * self.e x ≠ 0
